entries.title: Create validation accepts an empty content string
entries.summary: validateCreateInput in src/utils/validation.ts accepts content "" on create. It only checks typeof content === 'string', so an empty string passes and the note is created with empty content.

entries.title: Title max length (100) is enforced on create only, not update
entries.summary: validateCreateInput rejects titles whose trimmed length exceeds MAX_TITLE_LENGTH (100); validateUpdateInput deliberately has no length limit, so PATCH/PUT can still set a longer title.

demotions.note: At kb834/p2 HEAD, validateCreateInput in src/utils/validation.ts rejects titles whose trimmed length is over MAX_TITLE_LENGTH = 100. The claim says no maximum-length check exists, which this sprint made false. tests/validation.test.ts covers the 101-character rejection, and it passes.
